\newcommand{\aiMilestoneKey}{%
\textbf{1}~Oct~26: Project set up: notes scaffold and source manifest \\
\textbf{2}~Oct~27: Gate G0: one bound for every pairing cannot reach the target scale \\
\textbf{3}~Oct~27: Gate G1: all fifteen order-four white-noise terms computed \\
\textbf{4}~Oct~28: Upper bound at the correct time scale established after review \\
\textbf{5}~Oct~31: Goal revised: derive the actual constant, not match a predicted value \\
\textbf{6}~Nov~1: Variational formula for the second-moment constant integrated \\
\textbf{7}~Nov~1: DeepSeek and Kimi become the reviewers \\
\textbf{8}~Nov~5: Reading edition of about twenty pages written \\
\textbf{9}~Nov~9: Lean checks reach the actual Gaussian objects \\
\textbf{10}~Nov~9: Fifth whole review: PASS WITH NOTES at MEDIUM, not accepted \\
\textbf{11}~Nov~9: Lean companion recorded \\
\textbf{12}~Nov~10: Technical text organized as a book \\
\textbf{13}~Nov~11: Appendix E added: the AI work in numbers \\
\textbf{14}~Nov~11: Lean correspondence gates closed through wave L4 \\
\textbf{15}~Nov~15: Final publication-facing PDF on master \\
}
